purpose: Prospective G2 acceptance for the original-weight FP8 MMA SM120 candidate, fixed before its complete-answer run. Numerical G1 and G4 acceptance remain separate and unfrozen.
requirements: Every answer reaches EOS with finish stop within 4096 tokens.
Thinking-mode answers contain reasoning and parsed final content.
Every must-pass assertion holds for every runtime answer.
Runtime task passes are at least the original oracle task passes, and oracle task passes are at least five.
Report every failure, including the original oracle fib(186) failure; no claim beyond this finite suite.
scope_note: Repeat this same suite and checker for each actual placement and bind its own manifest and execution configuration in the final policy. No tolerance is derived from candidate answers.
